summary: Show where pieces move without mistaking position cycles for complete puzzle state.
objective: Trace a cube move as cycles of piece positions, with orientation shown separately.
example_prompts: Trace a cube move as cycles of piece positions, with orientation shown separately.

entities.name: Position slots
entities.guidance: Keep fixed slot labels while identifiable pieces move; separate edge and corner groups.

entities.name: Cycle arcs
entities.guidance: Route directional arcs outside the solid; color by cycle and add order numbers.

entities.name: Orientation marks
entities.guidance: Use local face marks attached to pieces so twists remain visible after a cycle closes.

state_contract.model: Bijection from source slots to destination slots plus separate orientation state; derive cycles by visited-slot traversal.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Select a cycle and step its mapping.
Toggle fixed points, invert mapping and reset.

invariants: Each piece and destination appears exactly once in the permutation.
Cycle display must match the move engine, not a separately authored animation.
A returned position alone does not imply solved orientation.
motion_guidance: Interpolate visual travel separately from the exact mapping.
Freeze slot labels; show ghost source pieces to explain cycle direction.
known_limits: Cycle notation here is positional; legal-state validation still needs a complete puzzle model.
Do not advertise arbitrary user permutations as reachable cube states.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: A finite permutation decomposes into disjoint cycles; position cycles of cube pieces alone do not fully encode their orientations.
claims.scope: Finite piece-position permutation, not a facelet-only representation.

source_refs.locator: Section 5, disjoint cycles and cube orientation discussion

object_craft.material: Neutral slot markers, distinguishable piece faces and contrasting numbered cycle arcs; preserve local orientation marks during motion.
object_craft.articulation: Piece-local orientation marks follow pieces; fixed slot labels never inherit the moving piece transform.
